BRAND_SUBTITLE_DASHBOARD: Pedagogical monitoring - Juice Shop M2 lab
EMPTY_NO_EVENTS_TITLE: No event received for this cohort
EMPTY_NO_EVENTS_BODY: Students must join the cohort from the JuiceLab overlay in Juice Shop. After approval, their events will appear here.
TABLE_EMPTY_STUDENTS: No student. Add one manually or wait for an overlay to send its first event.
SECTION_EXISTING_COHORTS_META: Create, rename or delete a cohort
SECTION_PENDING_BODY: Approving unlocks them on /api/sync. Rejecting returns 403 on their next events.
SECTION_ROSTER_META: Edit the name inline (Enter = save, Escape = cancel). Manual add via the bottom row.
PROMPT_COHORT_ID: Cohort ID (alnum, dash, underscore, dot, max 64):
CONFIRM_RESET: Reset cohort {cohort}? All events + student roster will be REMOVED. The cohort itself stays.
CONFIRM_DELETE: DELETE cohort {cohort}? Cohort + events + students PERMANENTLY removed.
CONFIRM_RESET_GENERIC: Reset events + students for "{cohort}"? The cohort stays.
CONFIRM_REJECT: Reject this request? The student will be blocked on /api/sync.
CONFIRM_DELETE_STUDENT: Remove the roster entry for {token}? Historical events are kept.
LOGIN_LEAD: Enter the teacher token (DASHBOARD_TEACHER_TOKEN) to access the cohort dashboard.
LOGIN_META: The token is stored in an HttpOnly cookie. Hit /logout to remove it.
HELP_S1_BODY: Three actors interact: (1) the teacher creates a cohort from /admin/cohorts, (2) the student joins from the JuiceLab overlay inside Juice Shop with the cohort code + their email, (3) the teacher approves the request. The student's events are then accepted on /api/sync and appear in the live dashboard.
HELP_S1_STEP_1: Teacher: open /admin/cohorts -> enter an identifier (alnum + - _ .) + label -> Create.
HELP_S1_STEP_2: Student: open Juice Shop -> JuiceLab overlay -> first-launch modal -> enter dashboard URL, cohort code, email -> Request access.
HELP_S1_STEP_3: Teacher: return to /admin/cohorts -> Pending requests section -> Approve (or Reject).
HELP_S1_STEP_4: Student: status flips to 'validated' on the next poll (60 s). Events stream automatically.
HELP_S2_BODY: The teacher dashboard supports FR and EN. On the Juice Shop side, the student inherits the site language (FR / EN / BR). Language resolution order: URL ?lang=fr|en > cookie dash_lang > browser Accept-Language > default FR. The [FR | EN] switcher in the header sets a 1-year persistent cookie.
HELP_S3_BODY: The teacher token (DASHBOARD_TEACHER_TOKEN) must NOT be edited from the UI. It is a config secret. Proper rotation:
HELP_S3_DANGER: Why not via UX: (a) compromised UI = self-service escalation, (b) lockout on typo, (c) any change to secrets invalidates already-signed proofs (DASHBOARD_PROOF_SECRET), (d) the token would leak in HTTP logs.
HELP_S3_CLI_1: Generate a token >= 16 chars: openssl rand -hex 32
HELP_S3_CLI_2: Edit the environment file (.env, systemd unit, docker-compose) with DASHBOARD_TEACHER_TOKEN=<new>
HELP_S3_CLI_3: Restart the dashboard: bash juice.sh restart dash
HELP_S3_CLI_4: Hand the new token to the teacher (out-of-band channel, never plaintext email).
HELP_S4_BODY: GET /api/cohorts (list), POST /api/cohorts (create), DELETE /api/cohorts/<cid>, POST /api/cohorts/<cid>/reset, GET /api/students/pending?cohort=, POST /api/students/<token>/approve|/reject, POST /api/sync (gated). All except join+exists+status require X-Teacher-Token.
HELP_S5_BODY: No events received? Check: (1) cohort_id exists (/admin/cohorts), (2) student status = 'validated' (/admin/students), (3) dashboard URL correct on the student side (cohort settings gear in overlay), (4) Juice Shop instance reachable from the student's browser.
DIPLOMA_VERIFY_BODY: Any modification of this block invalidates the signature. Verify via dashboard/verify_proof.py with DASHBOARD_PROOF_SECRET.
TOOLBAR_EXPORT_CSV_TITLE: Download the cohort as CSV (Excel-compatible UTF-8 BOM)
